clipboard.allGoalsTip: Shows all {total} goals. {req} are required for Inspection Day. Done: {done}/{total}.
clipboard.closeTip: Closes the list. A tap anywhere else closes it too.
clipboard.closeCardTip: Folds the clipboard back into the small chip.
clipboard.skipTip: Skips the remaining {left} of {total} tutorial steps. The goals start right away.
clipboard.chipTip: Opens the clipboard with the current goal.
clipboard.fbody.callInspection: All required goals are done. Call the goose inspector and earn your first stars.
clipboard.fbody.stars2: Raise your weakest grade, then inspect again for 2★ and bonus keys.
clipboard.fbody.stars3: All grades B or better and one A: 3★ and the biggest key bonus.
clipboard.fbody.transfer: Cash in your golden keys: start a fresh lockup with perks.
clipboard.why.wash: Muddy rascals shower here – clean rascals are happy
clipboard.why.workshop: Rascals knit crates here: coins and reform
clipboard.why.classroom: Lessons reform rascals fastest – more releases
clipboard.why.guard: Guards stop escapes – escapes cost reputation
clipboard.why.beds12: No bed, no newcomers – the ferry sails on
clipboard.why.yard: Fun lifts the mood – cheerful rascals reform faster
clipboard.why.canteen5: More meals per hour – hungry rascals grumble
clipboard.why.catch3: Tap runaways – every catch pays coins and reputation
clipboard.why.beds24: More beds, more arrivals, more releases
clipboard.why.release20: Releases pay the most – reform them, then out they go
clipboard.why.workshop15: Upgrade the Knitting Nook: more crates, more coins
clipboard.first.foreman: First hire a Foreman: the Nook knits at full speed
clipboard.first.teacher: First hire a Teacher: no teacher, no lessons
clipboard.first.guard: First hire a Guard: the post is empty
clipboard.buildTip: Opens the building tool for the {room} ({cost} coins). Drag it out on the map – a ghost shows a good spot.
clipboard.loop: Reform rascals → release them → coins & stars
clipboard.loopTip: Rascals arrive by ferry. Keep them fed, clean and busy: knitting and lessons reform them. Reformed rascals walk out through the Parole Gate and pay coins and reputation. Stars unlock new rooms and systems.
